summary: PASS. python .pmcro/tests/run_all.py returned OVERALL PASS on Python 3.14.5 across eleven steps: 45 gate tests in four suites, host boundary preflight with zero FAIL and zero UNMAPPED, scripts compile, five marketplace manifests synchronized, content manifest current, 115 JSON files parsed, 45 TrailFrames valid with 6 LEGACY, 9 checkpoints valid.
